snippet.title: TURNBOUND A NEW HERO ENTERS THE GAME!
snippet.description:
Turnbound has a new hero and 1.0 release date! 

Dive into this auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler.

Play Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802470/Turnbound/

#turnbound #turnbased #turnbased #inventorymanagement #indiegame
